text: {"final": {"summary": "In register_household (registry/register.py), added a validation check after Household.from_dict builds the household and before any append/save: if not is_valid_household_id(household.id), raise ValueError(f\"Invalid household ID: {household.id}\"). Imported is_valid_household_id from core.ids. The check runs before save_households, so a rejected ID persists nothing; auto-assignment is unaffected since next_household_id always returns a valid ID, and the existing region/members/duplicate validations are unchanged.", "done_steps": ["P1"]}}
